claim_rule: This ledger authenticates frontier baseline authorities and comparability blockers only. No listed frontier baseline has been retrained on the FrameContact double-cold split or scored on a FrameContact frozen test, and no published number is a FrameContact head-to-head result.

deepssinter.architecture_boundary: ESM2 plus SaProt features, intra-chain distance and graph representations, ResNet-Inception and triangle-aware interaction modules over two monomer structures

checkpoint.serialization: PyTorch Lightning pickle checkpoint; do not deserialize outside an isolated audited environment

deepssinter.comparability_boundary: The paper uses minimum-heavy-atom distance below 6 A, whereas the current FrameContact development authority uses its frozen 4.5 A contact definition. Upstream training data, redundancy control, monomer source, cropping and residue scope must be audited and harmonized before comparison.
deepssinter.license_boundary: The pinned repository has no LICENSE or COPYING file. Its README simultaneously says academic/non-commercial use and GNU GPL v3, so copying, redistribution and commercial-use permissions are not treated as resolved.

handshake.architecture_boundary: ProstT5 with LoRA, bidirectional cross-chain attention, residue heads and contact supervision
handshake.comparability_boundary: Default random pair splitting is not endpoint-disjoint; concatenated endpoint clustering does not prove endpoint disjointness; contact export switches to train mode; the generic inference-only path can tune a threshold on its labeled inference set.
handshake.license_boundary: No LICENSE or COPYING file at the pinned revision; do not copy or redistribute source. Use a clean-room paper-level control.

prostt5_cross_contact_control.comparability_boundary: Pretraining uses 17 million AlphaFoldDB structures; training cutoff and overlap with SAbDab2 must be audited. It is an externally pretrained representation control, not data-equivalent to frozen ESM2.
prostt5_cross_contact_control.license_boundary: The official model card declares MIT, but no standalone LICENSE file was found at the pinned model revision. Preserve the model-card license declaration and do not infer permissions beyond it.
prostt5_cross_contact_control.weight_custody: The current official tree exposes an approximately 11.3 GB pytorch_model.bin with pickle imports. No local weight hash or safe converted artifact exists yet.

protact.architecture_boundary: SE(3)-invariant monomer encoders, surface features and a trigonometry interaction module initialized from the outer product of node embeddings
protact.comparability_boundary: The published contact definition is minimum-heavy-atom distance below 6 A, maximum monomer length is 256, and training may use label-informed contact-rich crops. Published SAbDab results therefore cannot be compared directly with the FrameContact double-cold full-axis task.
protact.license_boundary: No LICENSE or COPYING file at the pinned revision; source may be inspected but is not copied into FrameContact.

parent.reason: Add 2026 partner-aware and contact-map frontier authorities without rewriting the previously frozen GVP, EGNN, IPA and Pairformer ledger.
